subject: FDA ANDA Submission - Metformin ER 500mg - Ready for Filing
body:
Hi team,

The ANDA package for Metformin Extended Release 500mg is complete and ready for submission to the FDA. Bioequivalence study reports, stability data (24-month), and DMF references have all been cross-verified against the checklist.

Could we schedule a final review call before Friday's filing deadline? I want to make sure the CMC section aligns with the latest Module 3 guidance.

Regards,
Sandeep Rao
Regulatory Affairs Manager, DO Systems Pharma Division

subject: Distributor Agreement Renewal - South Zone (Apollo & MedPlus)
body:
Hi Sandeep,

Following up on the distributor agreement renewal with Apollo Pharmacy and MedPlus for the South Zone. Both parties have agreed to a 12% volume-based rebate structure for FY26-27, contingent on maintaining the current SKU list for our antihypertensive range.

Legal has flagged one clause around minimum order quantities that we need to revisit. Can we align on this before Wednesday's call with their procurement head?

Thanks,
Vinay Mehta
Head of Business Development - Pharma, DO Systems

subject: Phase II Trial Update - Compound DS-4471 (Diabetic Neuropathy)
body:
Hi all,

Enrollment for the Phase II trial of DS-4471 has crossed 68% of target (170/250 patients) across the 6 trial sites. Interim safety review by the DSMB is scheduled for next month, with no adverse signals reported so far.

Site 4 (Chennai) has reported slower recruitment - I'm coordinating with the CRO to reassess timelines. Will circulate the interim CRF summary by end of week.

Best,
Dr. Deva Krishnan
Clinical Research Associate, DO Systems Pharma Division

subject: Batch Deviation Report - Lot #PZ2206 (Pantoprazole 40mg)
body:
Team,

A minor deviation was flagged during in-process QC for Lot #PZ2206 - dissolution rate at the 30-minute mark was slightly below the acceptance criteria (78% vs 80% specified). Root cause investigation points to a coating pan temperature fluctuation.

QA has quarantined the batch pending CAPA closure. I'll need sign-off from Quality Head before we can proceed with release testing. Please treat this as priority.

Regards,
Sandeep Rao
Regulatory Affairs Manager

subject: Pricing Negotiation - Government Tender for Insulin Glargine
body:
Hi Sandeep, Deva,

The state health department tender for Insulin Glargine (10ml vials) closes on the 28th. Our quoted price is competitive but we're up against two generic manufacturers undercutting by ~6%.

I'd like to propose a bundled offer including cold-chain logistics support to differentiate our bid. Can Deva's team confirm current production capacity for a 50,000-unit order within 45 days?

Thanks,
Vinay Mehta
Head of Business Development - Pharma

subject: Adverse Event Report - Serious Case (Trial DS-4471, Site 2)
body:
Hi Sandeep,

Flagging a serious adverse event reported at Site 2 (Bengaluru) - a participant experienced Grade 3 hypersensitivity reaction, resolved with standard treatment, patient stable and discharged.

SAE report has been filed with the Ethics Committee within the mandated 24-hour window. Regulatory notification to CDSCO is due within 14 days - please confirm you have what you need from our end to prepare the submission.

Best,
Dr. Deva Krishnan
Clinical Research Associate

subject: EU GMP Inspection - Preparedness Review (Unit 3, Vizag)
body:
Hi team,

We've received notice of an upcoming EU GMP inspection for Unit 3 in Vizag, tentatively scheduled for next quarter. I'm setting up mock audit sessions covering data integrity, cleaning validation, and warehouse cold storage compliance.

Would appreciate Vinay's input on any commercial commitments tied to EU-bound shipments that might be affected if we need a production hold during prep.

Regards,
Sandeep Rao
Regulatory Affairs Manager

subject: New Product Launch - Rosuvastatin + Aspirin FDC
body:
Hi all,

Marketing has finalized the launch plan for our new Rosuvastatin 10mg + Aspirin 75mg fixed-dose combination, targeting Q3 release. Sales training decks are ready, and we've lined up 40 cardiologist CME sessions across metro cities.

Sandeep, can you confirm the labeling approval status? We can't finalize packaging artwork until that's locked.

Thanks,
Vinay Mehta
Head of Business Development - Pharma

subject: Cold Chain Logistics Audit - Vaccine Storage Facility
body:
Hi Vinay,

Completed the cold chain audit for our vaccine storage facility ahead of the tender submission. Temperature logs show consistent 2-8°C maintenance over the last 90 days with only one brief excursion (backup generator kicked in within 4 minutes).

This should strengthen our bid for the government cold-chain compliance requirement. Full audit report attached for your records.

Best,
Dr. Deva Krishnan
Clinical Research Associate

subject: Patent Expiry Strategy - Atorvastatin Franchise (2027)
body:
Hi Vinay,

With the innovator patent on our reference Atorvastatin product expiring in early 2027, I'd like to start aligning our generic filing timeline with commercial launch readiness. We should file the ANDA at least 18 months ahead to account for review cycles.

Can we set up a joint regulatory-commercial planning session next week to map this out?

Regards,
Sandeep Rao
Regulatory Affairs Manager

subject: Sample Shipment Tracking - Clinical Trial Kits (Site 5, Hyderabad)
body:
Hi Deva,

The clinical trial drug kits for Site 5 in Hyderabad were dispatched via temperature-controlled courier yesterday and are expected to arrive tomorrow morning. Tracking confirms cold-chain integrity maintained throughout transit so far.

Please have the site coordinator confirm receipt and temperature log download once the shipment lands.

Thanks,
Vinay Mehta
Head of Business Development - Pharma

subject: Quarterly Pharmacovigilance Summary - Q2 FY26
body:
Hi team,

Sharing the Q2 pharmacovigilance summary: 12 adverse event reports logged across all marketed products, none classified as unexpected serious reactions. Signal detection review shows no new safety concerns requiring label updates.

Full PSUR draft will be circulated for review before submission to CDSCO next week.

Regards,
Sandeep Rao
Regulatory Affairs Manager

subject: Meeting Invite: ANDA Final Review Call - {{tomorrow}}, 10:30 AM IST
body:
Hi team,

Blocking calendars for the final ANDA review call before the Metformin ER filing goes out.

When: {{tomorrow}}, 10:30 AM - 11:30 AM IST
Where: Teams (link in calendar invite)

Agenda:
1. CMC section walkthrough vs Module 3 guidance (Sandeep)
2. Bioequivalence data cross-check (Deva)
3. Final sign-off checklist and submission logistics

Please come prepared with your section reviews - we have one shot to get this in before the deadline. Coffee on me if we wrap up early!

Regards,
Sandeep Rao
Regulatory Affairs Manager

subject: Meeting: Apollo & MedPlus Negotiation Prep - {{monday}} 3:00 PM
body:
Hi Sandeep,

Setting up a 45-minute prep session on {{monday}} at 3:00 PM before we face their procurement head on Wednesday.

What I need from you before the meeting:
- Your read on the minimum order quantity clause Legal flagged
- Any regulatory constraints on the SKU list commitments

I'll bring the revised rebate model and last year's volume actuals. Let's walk in with a united front - these folks negotiate hard.

Grab the invite from your calendar. Samosas will be provided. :)

Thanks,
Vinay Mehta
Head of Business Development - Pharma

subject: DSMB Interim Safety Review scheduled for {{+7d}} - prep checklist inside
body:
Hi all,

Good news - the DSMB has confirmed the interim safety review for DS-4471 on {{+7d}}, 9:00 AM IST. This is the big one for our Phase II momentum.

Prep checklist:
- Safety listings frozen and validated by {{+4d}} (my team)
- SAE narrative for the Site 2 case finalized (done, under QC)
- Enrollment and demographics tables refreshed with this week's numbers

If the review goes clean, we're on track to hit full enrollment ahead of schedule. Fingers crossed - this compound keeps looking better every cut of the data.

Best,
Dr. Deva Krishnan
Clinical Research Associate

subject: Mock GMP Audit Kickoff - Unit 3 Vizag - {{+3d}}, 9:00 AM
body:
Hi team,

First mock audit session for the EU GMP inspection prep kicks off on {{+3d}} at 9:00 AM, Unit 3 conference room (Vizag). Auditors from our Quality consulting partner will run it exactly like the real thing - badge checks and all.

Day 1 scope: data integrity walkthrough and batch record review.
Day 2 ({{+4d}}): cleaning validation and cold storage compliance.

Vinay - still waiting on your list of EU-bound commercial commitments so we can plan around any production hold. Can you send it before the kickoff?

Regards,
Sandeep Rao
Regulatory Affairs Manager

subject: Rescheduled: Insulin Glargine Tender Strategy Call moved to {{friday}}
body:
Hi Sandeep, Deva,

Heads up - the state health department pushed their pre-bid clarification meeting, so I'm moving our tender strategy call from {{tomorrow}} to {{friday}}, 11:00 AM IST. Updated invite is on its way.

Silver lining: the extra days give Deva's team time to confirm the 50,000-unit production capacity number, and me time to price out the cold-chain logistics bundle properly.

Deva - if I can get that capacity confirmation by {{+2d}}, I can lock the final bid numbers over the weekend.

Thanks,
Vinay Mehta
Head of Business Development - Pharma

subject: Team Sync: All-Hands Pharma Division Review - {{today}} 5:30 PM (quick one!)
body:
Hi both,

Quick 30-minute sync at 5:30 PM today ({{today}}) to round up the week before things get hectic:

- Trial enrollment update and the DSMB prep (me, 10 min)
- Tender bid status and Apollo/MedPlus renewal (Vinay, 10 min)
- ANDA filing readiness and mock audit plan (Sandeep, 10 min)

No slides needed - just talking points. Dial in from wherever you are; I know Vinay is traveling.

See you at 5:30!

Best,
Dr. Deva Krishnan
Clinical Research Associate
